ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The ventral surface displays a dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution covering approximately 98% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized, small-scale surface marks and scratches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark pigmentation with non-contiguous, high-contrast white focal points (punctate spots) distributed across the central and lateral regions of both lobes, and fine linear white disruptions clustered in the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp, symmetric V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 75 degrees and a deep, defined vertex dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration across the entire trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits more jagged, saw-tooth peaks (varying from 2-8 pixels in depth) while the left lobe shows slightly more rounded, though still irregular, topographical variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge sweep that tapers from the distal tips toward the median notch, with the leading edge appearing straight to slightly convex toward the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-4 pixels in diameter) are visible, particularly near the trailing edge and the upper-middle section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, fine, white linear pixel disruptions are visible; notable rake-like scratches appear on the upper-left lobe and short horizontal streaks on the upper-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: No major physical trauma or amputations are detected; anomalous markings are limited to minor surface abrasions and punctate scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and ragged trailing edge topography with deep individual notches that provide a unique edge profile relative to standard serration patterns.
